digest.component_or_area: GitHub Actions CI workflow / macOS pytest execution
propositions: macOS pytest temporary Git repositories were moved from runner.temp to a 2 GiB APFS RAM disk at /Volumes/RebarTests to test if reducing filesystem latency would improve test wall time.

Exact no-RAM control run 31868300174 completed the default suite in 17m26s and the macOS job in 20m36s, while all RAM-disk treatment runs (31869753711, 31869919362, 31870391571, 31873067707) completed default in 18m26s–20m54s, each slower than control and missing the predeclared 5% improvement threshold.

The experiment exposed owner-nonwritable workflow snapshot fixtures that made recursive basetemp cleanup fail with PermissionError, and a nested pytest cacheprovider leak that violated test isolation.

The storage hypothesis was rejected; the RAM-disk lifecycle was removed and both pytest tiers were restored to runner.temp, with snapshot permission repair and cacheprovider hygiene fixes retained as test-local improvements.
Selection, markers, worker counts, timeouts, Python versions, platform matrix, coverage behavior, and collection counts remained unchanged throughout the experiment and final revert.
Merged change 1806 removes the ephemeral RAM-disk setup, reporting, recursive release, and detach lifecycle while preserving unchanged baseline assertions and test fidelity.
